## mddeck v0.1.8 — speaker notes, font-size utilities, PDF rendering fixes

### Highlights

- **`_note` directive** for impress.js's `P`-key speaker console.
  Write notes in plain Markdown inside `<!-- _note: ... -->` and
  the speaker console renders them in a separate window.
- **Font-size utility classes** (`tiny` / `small` / `normal` /
  `big` / `huge`) ship with all six built-in themes. Apply with
  `<!-- _class: name -->`.
- **PDF export** renders all slides at full size (no more blank
  pages, no more tiny letterboxed content).
- **`![bg left:N%](image)`** layouts now push text beside the image
  instead of over it.

### Notes

- Deprecates 0.1.4 / 0.1.5 / 0.1.6 / 0.1.7. Direct upgrade to 0.1.8
  recommended.
- Public API unchanged.
- See `CHANGELOG.md` for the full set of fixes.

### Install

```bash
npm install --save-dev @machine-w/mddeck-cli
```
